components.name: HudTitleBar
components.notes: Top title bar with label + title + subtitle. V3 has basic scene-label, V3 should adopt full HudTitleBar with title/subtitle zones

components.name: GridBackground
components.notes: Grid overlay with animation. V3's bg-grid is simpler version of this. V3 has this already.

components.name: ScanOverlay
components.notes: Screen-edge scan effect. Nice-to-have but not critical for V3.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.notes: V3 already has #combined-progress but it's debug-style. Should adopt V2's more polished version.

components.name: MetricRail
components.notes: Left-side vertical scrolling metric display. V3 doesn't have this. Should be ported for data-heavy scenes.

components.name: MetricCard
components.notes: Individual metric card. V3 has basic metric-card in fallback template. Should upgrade to V2's version.

components.name: DataCounter
components.notes: Animated count-up number. V3 doesn't have this. Should port for KPI display scenes.

components.name: CardMatrix
components.notes: 3-column mini-card matrix. V3's pain_card_stack is similar but less polished. Should adopt V2's version.

components.name: ProcessTimeline
components.notes: Horizontal step timeline with nodes and connectors. V3's broken_chain is a primitive version of this. Should upgrade to V2's ProcessTimeline.

components.name: Checklist
components.notes: Numbered action list. V3's checklist_cta is functionally similar but V2's has better hover states and motion.

components.name: ScorePanel
components.notes: Multi-dimensional rating display. V3 doesn't have this. Should port for before/after comparison.

components.name: TablePanel
components.notes: Structured data table. V3 doesn't have a table layout. Should port for comparison scenes.

components.name: CtaPanel
components.notes: Call-to-action panel with button states. V3's checklist_cta lacks button-style CTA. Should adopt.

components.name: BottomCaption
components.notes: Bottom caption/subtitle overlay. V3 has this but V2's has proper motion-target and GSAP binding.

components.name: Headline
components.notes: Main title text. V3 has this but with less sophisticated motion binding.

components.name: Subheadline
components.notes: Subtitle/secondary text. V3 doesn't have a dedicated subheadline component.

effects.name: grid_drift
effects.notes: Background grid drifts slowly. V3 already has this in combined_html_builder.

effects.name: glow_pulse
effects.notes: Background glow pulses. V3 already has this in combined_html_builder.

effects.name: fade_in_out
effects.notes: Scene fade in/out. V3 has this in _build_master_timeline but V2's is more sophisticated with crossfade.

effects.name: card_stack_reveal
effects.notes: Cards stack up with stagger reveal. V3's pain_card_stack has basic GSAP but V2's is more polished.

effects.name: node_pop_in
effects.notes: Timeline nodes pop in with elastic easing. V3's broken_chain uses back.out(1.2) which is similar.

transitions.name: cards_to_path
transitions.notes: Card stack dissolves into path/chain. V3 doesn't have semantic transitions for scene changes.

transitions.name: path_to_broken_flow
transitions.notes: Path transforms into broken chain with visual break effect.

transitions.name: timeline_to_cards
transitions.notes: Timeline reconstructs into card columns. V3's tool_chain_three_cols should use this transition.

transitions.name: table_to_checklist
transitions.notes: Table dissolves into checklist items. V3 should use this for S07→S08.

caption_styles.name: bottom_center_caption
caption_styles.notes: Bottom-center caption with rounded background. V3 has this but V2's has proper GSAP binding.

caption_styles.name: side_tag_badge
caption_styles.notes: Side tag/badge for scene labels. V3 doesn't have this.

layout_zones.name: top_progress
layout_zones.notes: V3 uses this for #combined-progress but as debug bar only.

layout_zones.name: center_panel
layout_zones.notes: V3 has center_panel concept but no zone-based layout system.

layout_zones.name: bottom_caption
layout_zones.notes: V3's caption system uses this zone.

layout_zones.name: left_indicator
layout_zones.notes: V3 doesn't have left indicator rail. MetricRail should use this zone.
